cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. That's applause. Our real mission is entertaining base. I'm singing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they've switched off. You've lost our audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. I'm handing you the microphone; refuse me a second verse.

mechanism: A directs ship communication, supplies B forecast need and converts rejected reporting into receiving, entertainment and an enacted rejection exercise.
confusable: Unlike calling every failure planned success, each failure reveals a different mission with a new task.
comparison: Radio work and an audience loss differ from torch-lit wall exploration.
seedUse: D161-b report, static, forecast and microphone; S02-b gives B useful material while changing roles.
